acquiring.settleNote: Acquiring-chain metric-window settle (O4). Without --settle, wait is derived per case from the indicator window suffix (_5m/_2h/_1d): seconds = clamp(window*factor, floorSeconds, capSeconds); windows >= 1 day use naturalDaySeconds; no suffix falls back to defaultSeconds. An explicit --settle <seconds> overrides all cases. Tune here, not in code, for environments with different materialization lag.
